note: Two independent published gold prices, each stored with the publisher's own timestamp. Neither is an estimate. The primary reading was refreshed in pass P12; earlier readings are kept in previous_readings so the calculator can be re-run against the price a row was captured with. The COMEX cross-check is the reading taken earlier in the same session and is labelled with its own timestamp.

primary.label: Gold spot, USD per troy ounce

cross_check.label: COMEX gold futures, front month (GC=F), USD per troy ounce
cross_check.note: Futures price, not spot. Shown only as a cross-check that the spot figure is in the right market range.

disclaimer: A gold price is not an appraisal. Jewellery sells for more than its metal because of labour, setting, stones and margin. Use the melt value only as a floor to spot absurd pricing.

previous_readings.label: Gold spot, USD per troy ounce
previous_readings.why: Re-read in pass P12 to keep the value check on the newest published price.
